cosmos_wam_qualification.basis: The corrected official DROID active/no-motion pair was structurally valid, but no-motion changed more overall, recorded timing correlation was -0.460018, the wrist null moved more, and the two exterior views were nearly static. One window and non-prospectively-frozen diagnostic thresholds are insufficient for powered falsification, so Blueprint abstained and awarded no qualification credit.

frozen_benchmark_calibration.basis: The complete 441-episode known-answer reproduction failed rank and selective-use gates. Gemini 3.6 Flash was promising only after label exposure and never abstained.

captured_site_transfer.basis: Not admitted or measured; no same-site independently attributable physical outcomes exist.

economics_and_speed.basis: Digital canary cost was measured, but no useful ranking completed and no defensible exhaustive physical baseline was available.

phase_b.design_achieved: single published-reference open-loop native-Cosmos paired causal diagnostic
phase_b.claim_ceiling: deployment and causal-screen diagnostic only; no closed-loop, ranking, or generalization credit
